verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a platform-wide `gcloud` CLI reference and a machine-readable Discovery Document "for each API". The APIs Explorer is embedded on REST method reference pages, and even a non-flagship service like Billing has its own REST reference. Together these show reference coverage that is uniform and goes beyond the flagship services. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that reference quality is consistent across the long tail of services, an explicit inventory showing every service has CLI and REST reference pages, and an OpenAPI-standard format (Discovery is Google-proprietary).

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: a machine-readable \"Discovery Document\" for each API
